title: pr-upkeep human gate decision
description: The decision payload for the human-approves-pr node. The outcome itself is selected from the task's allowed_outcomes (approved / changes_required / rejected / expired); this schema shapes the accompanying response. `approved` is a statement of fact — the approver merged the PR themselves; the flow holds no merge credential (see README.md, the human-merges rule). The compiler leaves decisionSchemaRef unresolved (resolving needs a source root, PRD §11.4), so this file documents the contract for the inbox surface rather than being enforced at publish time.

notes.description: Required for changes_required (what must change, for the fix node's next pass via decision_history) and for rejected (why the item is dropped); optional for approved.

merged_pr.description: For approved: the PR URL or number the approver merged, recorded as part of the approval act.
